description: Syrache is a portmanteau blend of Syrah and Grenache produced by Ampelos Cellars from their estate Ampelos Vineyard in the Sta. Rita Hills AVA, a cool-climate region of Santa Barbara County known for maritime influence and diatomaceous, sandy-clay soils. The estate farms biodynamically and certified organic, with the blend intended to showcase the synergy between the two Rhône varieties grown side by side.
